name: A Wife’s Life – Part 2
source:
The same world, the same problems… Just different people.

The game tells the story of a young couple moving to a new city, and… Yeah, we’ve heard that one before somewhere. But how will fate turn out for these people? Who knows…

[From the [url=https://scyxar.com/a-wifes-life-part-2/]official site[/url]]
translation:
同样的世界，同样的问题……只是不同的人。

该游戏讲述了一对年轻夫妇搬到新城市的故事，并且……是的，我们以前在某处听说过这个故事。但这些人的命运又会如何呢？谁知道……

[来自[url=https://scyxar.com/a-wifes-life-part-2/]官方网站[/url]]
